name: schema_version
description: This field identifies the data contract version, not a claim of implementation readiness.

name: decisions
description: These records contain one supported outcome for every extracted claim.

name: claim_id
description: This identifier refers to one extracted teacher claim.

name: unit_id
description: This identifier refers to the exact reviewed detection unit.

name: decision
description: This field states the supported mapping outcome for one claim.

name: duplicate_of_claim_id
description: This identifier refers to an earlier compatible nonduplicate claim.

name: category_id
description: This field contains the mapped category that the teacher explicitly supplied.

name: correction
description: This flag or object describes correction requirements or decisions in its parent contract.

name: explanation
description: This flag or object describes explanation requirements or judgments in its parent contract.

name: evidence_ids
description: These IDs identify actual supporting records within the permitted subject and version scope.

name: reason_code
description: This code states the supported cause for the mapping outcome.

name: note
description: This text records contextual information without authority to override a failed gate.

name: supplied
description: This flag records whether the source teacher text actually contains the relevant component.

name: option_id
description: This identifier selects one existing reviewed correction option.

name: satisfied_proposition_ids
description: These existing required propositions match the actual teacher answer.

name: violated_proposition_ids
description: These existing forbidden propositions occur in the actual teacher response.

name: status
description: This field states the parent operation result from its declared enumeration.

name: support_evidence_ids
description: These IDs identify existing evidence within the judgment scope.

name: unresolved_reason
description: This code states why the correction or explanation cannot receive a resolved judgment.

name: supplied
description: This flag records whether the source teacher text actually contains the relevant component.

name: option_id
description: This identifier selects one existing reviewed correction option.

name: satisfied_proposition_ids
description: These existing required propositions match the actual teacher answer.

name: violated_proposition_ids
description: These existing forbidden propositions occur in the actual teacher response.

name: status
description: This field states the parent operation result from its declared enumeration.

name: support_evidence_ids
description: These IDs identify existing evidence within the judgment scope.

name: unresolved_reason
description: This code states why the correction or explanation cannot receive a resolved judgment.

name: schema_version
description: This field identifies the data contract version, not a claim of implementation readiness.

name: attempt_id
description: This identifier refers to the frozen teacher attempt.

name: case_version_id
description: This identifier refers to one immutable case version.

name: decision_set_sha256
description: This hash identifies the immutable set of decisions used for the score.

name: scoring_policy_version
description: This field identifies the exact formula and counting policy.

name: status
description: This field states the parent operation result from its declared enumeration.

name: counts
description: This object contains raw counts, not reduced metric fractions.

name: metrics
description: This object contains the registered metric results and applicability reasons.

name: domain_results
description: These results partition opportunities by their primary reporting domain.

name: composite
description: This object contains the policy-derived aggregate score and its applicability.

name: item_decision_ids
description: These IDs identify the saved decisions that support the feedback item.

name: semantic_judgments_present
description: This flag states that the result depends on semantic judgments in addition to arithmetic.

name: sufficient_statistics
description: These counts and sums permit exact recomputation of the metric ratios.

name: true_errors
description: This count gives all confirmed true-error units in the case.

name: tp
description: This count gives distinct supported true detections.

name: fn
description: This count gives missed true units.

name: fp
description: This count gives resolved false error assertions after duplicate removal.

name: designated_decoys
description: This count gives the reviewed permitted controls in the case.

name: decoy_false_positives
description: This count gives designated permitted units wrongly marked as errors.

name: duplicate_claims
description: This count identifies claims excluded from extra credit because they repeat a prior claim.

name: unresolved_claims
description: This count gives score-relevant claims that still require review.

name: detection.precision
description: This ratio measures supported error assertions among all distinct error assertions.

name: detection.recall
description: This ratio measures the true detection units that the teacher found.

name: detection.f1
description: This ratio combines detection precision and recall. If true opportunities exist and the teacher finds none, its value is zero.

name: detection.miss_rate
description: This ratio measures true units that the teacher missed.

name: detection.false_discovery_rate
description: This ratio measures unsupported error assertions among all distinct error assertions.

name: classification.coverage
description: This ratio measures detected units with a category that the teacher explicitly supplied.

name: classification.family_accuracy
description: This ratio measures correct primary domains among explicitly categorized detections.

name: classification.exact_accuracy
description: This ratio measures exact permitted taxonomy IDs among explicitly categorized detections.

name: classification.hierarchical_accuracy
description: This ratio measures tree-based category credit among explicitly categorized detections.

name: classification.hierarchical_recall
description: This ratio measures category credit across all true units. Missing detections and missing categories contribute zero.

name: correction.attempt_rate
description: This ratio measures proposed corrections among detected units that permit correction.

name: correction.strict_accuracy
description: This ratio measures fully correct corrections among proposed corrections of true detections.

name: correction.graded_accuracy
description: This ratio measures proposition-based correction credit among proposed corrections. The model cannot choose an arbitrary partial score.

name: correction.strict_recall
description: This ratio measures fully corrected units among all true units that permit correction.

name: correction.graded_recall
description: This ratio measures correction credit across all true correction opportunities. Missed units contribute zero.

name: correction.assertion_precision
description: This ratio measures fully correct repairs among repairs of true detections and unnecessary repairs.

name: explanation.coverage
description: This ratio measures proposed explanations among detected units that permit explanation.

name: explanation.strict_accuracy
description: This ratio measures fully correct explanations among proposed explanations of true detections.

name: explanation.graded_accuracy
description: This ratio measures proposition-based explanation credit among proposed explanations.

name: explanation.graded_recall
description: This ratio measures explanation credit across all true explanation opportunities. Missed units contribute zero.

name: decoy.overcorrection_rate
description: This ratio measures designated permitted units that the teacher wrongly marks as errors.

name: decoy.unflagged_rate
description: This ratio measures designated permitted units that the teacher does not mark as errors. Silence does not prove conscious recognition.

name: decoy.explicit_acceptability_accuracy
description: This ratio measures correct explicit judgments among explicitly judged negative controls.

name: acceptability.explicit_accuracy
description: This ratio measures correct explicit judgments among mapped units. Unsupported off-key assertions remain false positives outside this denominator.

name: weighted.precision
description: This ratio applies fixed severity weights to true detections. Each false positive has penalty one.

name: weighted.recall
description: This ratio applies the case weights to detected and missed opportunities. The case fixes these weights before answer entry.

name: weighted.f1
description: This ratio combines weighted precision and recall. It does not replace the unweighted metrics.
